title: torch.distributed failures on windows CI build
bug_description:
## Current Status
mitigated

## Error looks like
FAILED [0.0024s] test_fx.py::TestDCE::test_keep_collectives - AttributeError: module 'torch.distributed' has no attribute 'init_process_group'
([example](https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/actions/runs/17924309554/job/50972325815))

## Incident timeline (all times pacific)
9/21 morning - 9/22 2:11 pm

## User impact
windows CI build failures 

## Root cause
Revert of PR: https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/pull/162594 

## Mitigation
Reland PR with plans to forward fix internally 

## Prevention/followups
TBA
